envelope.description: Class field initializers, constructors and generator declarators keep their calls

body.title: Class field initializers, constructors and generator declarators keep their calls
body.summary: extractClass extracts calls with the class entity as caller from non-function field initializers (public_field_definition and field_definition) and from the constructor body; extractArrowFunction treats a generator_function value as a function, so a generator-valued declarator gets its own function entity and caller.
acceptanceChecks: Field-initializer and constructor-body calls are CALLS from the class entity in TS and JS sources.
A function-valued field is not credited to the class.
A generator-valued declarator gets a function entity whose calls are not credited to the file.

tests.name: src/indexer/parser/__tests__/typescript-module-level-calls.test.ts: in both TypeScript and JavaScript sources, calls in class field initializers (public_field_definition, field_definition) and the constructor body are CALLS from the class entity, a function-valued field is not credited to the class, and a generator-valued declarator gets its own function entity whose calls are not credited to the file
